blocks.text: ABOARD THE PAPAL PLANE — Pope Leo XIV on Monday warned concerns about artificial intelligence “should be taken seriously” but added he was not in “panic mode”. In wide-ranging comments, the pope also said parts of the Catholic Church had sometimes been “abusive” but said he would not call sex abuse “systemic” in the Church. “If someone were to ask me, am I in panic mode? No, I’m not. I sleep at night,” he told reporters at a press conference on the plane returning from his visit to France, referring to concerns about AI.
